data.title: Israel conditions Jordan water supply on softened rhetoric, fueling new crisis | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: The 1994 peace treaty signed by Amman and Jerusalem required Israel to supply Jordan with 50 million cubic meters of water annually, an amount doubled in a 2021 commitment that expired in 2025.
